content.text:
The user wants to create a new file named `data.txt` in the output directory.
The content of `data.txt` should be the combined content of `locations.txt` and `names.txt` which are located in the read-only directory.

1.  Identify the paths:
    *   Read-only files:
        *   `/var/folders/nj/bkj2m2nx3292lgx0x2zsh35h0000gn/T/agent-log-2572546028/readonly_agent_input/locations.txt` (Content: "London")
        *   `/var/folders/nj/bkj2m2nx3292lgx0x2zsh35h0000gn/T/agent-log-2572546028/readonly_agent_input/names.txt` (Content: "John Smith")
    *   Output directory: `/var/folders/nj/bkj2m2nx3292lgx0x2zsh35h0000gn/T/agent-log-2572546028/output`
    *   New file path: `/var/folders/nj/bkj2m2nx3292lgx0x2zsh35h0000gn/T/agent-log-2572546028/output/data.txt`

2.  Determine the content for `data.txt`:
    The user said "contain content of both files". This usually implies concatenation. I'll join them with a newline to be clean.
    Content: `London\nJohn Smith` (or similar). Let's check what the content actually was.
    `locations.txt` returned `"London"`.
    `names.txt` returned `"John Smith"`.
    Wait, looking at the previous tool outputs:
    `FSToolset_GetFileContentAsString{value: "London"}` (actually it's a string in JSON). Let's assume the content is just `London` and `John Smith`.

3.  Use `FSToolset_WriteStringToFile` to create the file.

tools.name: FSToolset_GetReadOnlyPaths
tools.description: GetReadOnlyPaths returns a list of paths that are allowed to be read-only from

tools.name: FSToolset_GetOutputDir
tools.description:
GetOutputDir returns the path of the output directory
in this directory read, write and delete operation are allowed

tools.name: FSToolset_GetFileContentAsString
tools.description:
GetFileContentAsString returns the content of the file at the given path as a string
error will be returned if the path is outside FSSandbox.readOnlyDirs or FSSandbox.outputDir
error will be returned if the path does not exist or is not accessible.

tools.name: FSToolset_GetFileContentAsBytes
tools.description:
GetFileContentAsBytes returns the content of the file at the given path as a []byte
error will be returned if the path is outside FSSandbox.readOnlyDirs or FSSandbox.outputDir
error will be returned if the path does not exist or is not accessible.

tools.name: FSToolset_WriteStringToFile
tools.description:
WriteStringToFile writes a given string into a specific file.
if the file does not exist, it will be created
error will be if the file already exists
error will be returned if the path is outside FSSandbox.outputDir

tools.name: FSToolset_WriteBytesToFile
tools.description:
WriteBytesToFile writes bytes into a specific file.
if the file does not exist, it will be created
error will be if the file already exists
error will be returned if the path is outside FSSandbox.outputDir

tools.name: FSToolset_DeleteFile
tools.description:
DeleteFile delete file.
error will be returned if the path is outside FSSandbox.outputDir
error will be returned in any other standard case during deletion

tools.name: FSToolset_ListFilesIn
tools.description:
ListFilesIn returns a list of files in the given path
error will be returned if the path does not exist or is not accessible.
error will be returned if the path is not a directory
error will be returned if the path is outside FSSandbox.readOnlyDirs or FSSandbox.outputDir
